notes: NEW subject pack: Research Methods Basics — the scientific method, variables (independent, dependent, control), experimental vs observational studies, random sampling vs random assignment, correlation vs causation, validity and reliability, statistical significance and p-values, and ethics in research, with which-idea, variable-ID, correlation-or-causation, and margin-of-error practice, never your assignment.

Detector V37 was trained and measured this run but HELD, not shipped: on the permanent frozen probe it caught 16 of 18 humanized texts, exactly the shipped V36’s 16 — the gate needs an improvement, not a tie — so V36 stays live until a round genuinely beats it. The round’s new formal-human dense set (200 real arXiv abstracts, human-written scholarly prose) did move the thing it targeted: formal-human false flags on the HuGPT set fell from 17.3% to 15.4%, modern-slice accuracy rose to 98.0%, and the false-flag rate stayed below V36’s at 4.64%. But GPT-5 detection slipped to 91.7% (from 94.1%), and the two probe misses (noise pollution, microplastics in the ocean) only moved closer without flipping.
